spans.s: mf(आ)n. having an object or business, ŚāṅkhBr.
anything that has attained its object, successful (as a request), Śak., Sch.
having property, opulent, wealthy, Rājat.
having meaning or purport, significant, important, Kusum.
of like meaning or purport, W.
serving a purpose, useful, serviceable, MW.
a travelling company of traders or pilgrims, caravan, MBh.; R. &c.
a troop, collection of men, MBh.
a multitude of similar animals, herd, flock &c., Pañcat.
any company (एन, with gen. = ‘in the company of’, Campak.), collection, multitude, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a member of any company, W.
a wealthy man, W.
सार्थ—घ्नी See -हन्.
सार्थ—ज mfn. born or reared in a caravan, tame (as an elephant), Nal.
सार्थ—धर m. N. of the leader of a c˚, Kathās.
सार्थ—पति m. the chief of a caravan, HPariś.
सार्थ—पाल m. the guardian of a c˚, MārkP.
सार्थ—भृत् m. = -वाह, Buddh.
सार्थ—भ्रंश-समुद्भव mfn. arising from the loss of a c˚, MBh.
सार्थ—मण्डल n. the circle or collected body of a c˚, ib.
सार्थ—वत् mfn. having some meaning or purpose or intention, significant, W.
having a numerous company, ib.
सार्थ—वाह m. the leader or conductor of a c˚, a merchant, trader, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the son of Māra (= मार-पुत्र), Buddh.
a Bodhisattva, ib.
सार्थ—वाह—वचस् n. the proclamation of the captain of a c˚, MBh.
सार्थ—वाहन m. the leader of a caravan, Kathās.
सार्थ—संचय mfn. possessing great wealth or riches, ib.
सार्थ—हन् mf(घ्नी)n. ‘caravan-destroyer’, a robber who attacks a caravan, MW.
सार्थ—हीन mfn. left behind by a caravan, R.
= सार्थ-पति, HPariś.
having meaning, significant, important, RPrāt.; Sāh.
serviceable, useful, advantageous, BhP.; Pañcar.
सार्थक—ता f. (KāśīKh.) significance, importance
सार्थक—त्व n. (Sāh.) significance, importance
the being adapted to any purpose, serviceableness, MW.
Nom. P. ˚यति, to make a profit or gain out of anything, Cat.
travelling with a caravan
a companion on a journey, merchant, trader, MBh.; BhP.
सार्थी-√ कृ P. -करोति = सार्थय above.
